CHATTOGRAM, Sept 14, 2022 (BSS) - Jute and Textiles Minister Golam Dastgir

Gazi Birpratik, MP said all closed mills under Bangladesh Jute Mill

Corporation (BJMC) will be opened in phases.

"The rental-based mills of BJMC have started production and export of jute

products under private management. These mills have created new employment

opportunities for many people in the country," he said.
